sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Unique-values dropdown (📊): added a "Reports - Trend" section for the `reports-index` pageType's own `reportChangeIndicator()` synthetic "Delta" column, which reads the leading trend arrow (▲/▼/↔) from the optional third-party "MusicBrainz: Reports Statistics" userscript's (by chaban) change-indicator span. Only visible when that third-party script is installed and active — the cell is otherwise empty, same as every other row on this pageType. Did not exist before this — see org/column-unique-value-drop-down-menu.org's "Analysis results" suggestion #3. New: `isDeltaCol` column-name gate, `_findCellReportTrend()`, three fixed structure-modes (`report-trend-up`/`-down`/`-flat`, sharing one section, same shape as `releaseDataQuality`/`acoustidLinkStatus`), and `_highlightReportTrendMatch()` (marks only the leading arrow glyph, never the count/percent text after it).
